l1_obstruction_and_tm_compression_scalin.diagnosis: L1 (`cross-check-trM-1ppb.witness.json` and `binding_combiner_markov_peel_fallback.py`) stopped at A <= 6 (`4He` at H_12 with p(12)=77, `6Li` at H_18 with p(18)=385) for two coupled reasons: (1) unfactored Hoefsmit Specht matrices on H_{3A} scale as p(3A) partitions and sum d_lambda^2 = (3A)! (reaching p(36)=17,977 and 36! ~ 3.72e41 at 12C), while unblocked markov_peel branches exponentially on non-commuting triples; and (2) raw 1D open-chain |tr_M(free)| - |tr_M(atom)| has only A-1 interfaces and w_lambda(z_D) = 0 on all ell(lambda) >= 3 blocks, omitting both 3D K_4 coordination and GPMT modified-trace cumulants. Block-ordered 2x2 transfer-matrix Groebner-Shirshov reduction (`crossingChain_eq_tmProduct_nf`) compresses C(A,2) crossings to O(A^2) steps, and H_4(q) + GPMT supplies the closed-shell K_4 cell algebra.
